rules.condition: A partially populated December row has no date of remittance.

rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: All active checks pass.
rules.exact_message: Validation successful. Click on 'Edit' if you wish to modify your entries.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and returns.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain with revision-aware wording.

rules.condition: Edited year is before 2018.
rules.exact_message:
Invalid data entry on item no. 1. 
Entry should be current or prior year but not be earlier than the effectivity date of January 2018.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Any normal four-digit year is compared with Date.getYear().
rules.exact_message:
Invalid data entry on item no. 1. 
Entry should be current or prior year but not be earlier than the effectivity date of January 2018.
rules.official_behavior: Date.getYear() returns current year minus 1900, so a normal year is replaced with a value such as 126 in 2026.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Use getFullYear(), enforce 2018 through the current full year, and preserve the entered year on a failed edit.

rules.condition: Date is not a valid MM/DD/YYYY calendar date.
rules.exact_message: Please provide a valid date. (MM/DD/YYYY format)
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Date is later than the current date.
rules.exact_message: This date cannot be a future date.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Date is before 2018.
rules.exact_message: This date cannot be prior to 2018.
rules.official_behavior: The branch alerts and stops the active operation.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Retain as a structured revision-aware error.

rules.condition: Every field in a schedule row is blank or zero.
rules.official_behavior: A fully blank/zero row passes.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Keep empty rows optional.

rules.condition: A populated row has nonzero tax withheld and zero penalties.
rules.official_behavior: The helper can fall through undefined, and callers ultimately accept the row.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Represent penalties as optional and avoid undefined control flow.

rules.condition: A nonblank malformed email is present.
rules.official_behavior: Email is optional and never format-checked.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Allow blank; validate format when nonblank.

rules.condition: Private category is selected but Item 8A is unanswered.
rules.official_behavior: Validate ignores Item 8A.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Require Item 8A when private category makes it applicable.

rules.condition: Commented Schedule 3 controls and computations are inspected.
rules.official_behavior: Schedule 3 validation and computation are wholly commented out.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Do not model commented controls as active behavior.

rules.condition: Final Copy is requested after successful validation.
rules.official_behavior: The source couples encrypted output to profile/connectivity behavior; no target-revision encrypted artifact was produced.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Keep deterministic local finalization separate from transport.

rules.condition: Online transport is invoked.
rules.official_behavior: Transport exists but was not exercised.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Keep local validation independently testable.
